## 1. Overview

This file is the single entry point for all R Markdown reports in the project.
Each section below describes one report: its purpose, output format, data dependencies,
and the exact `rmarkdown::render()` call needed to reproduce it.

| # | Report | Format | Layer |
|---|--------|--------|-------|
| 1 | SPY Regime & State Machine | HTML + PDF | Signal |
| 2 | Long/Short Overlay Portfolio | PDF | SAA/TAA |
| 3 | ETF Performance Report | HTML | Performance |
| 4 | Sovereign ETF Intelligence | Flexdashboard | Universe |
| 5 | Sentinel ETF Intelligence | Flexdashboard | Signal |

---

## 2. Active Reports

### 2.1 SPY Regime & State Machine

**File:** `spy_regime_statemachine_report.Rmd` (project root)

Documents the SPY drawdown cycle engine — a 3-state classification (Fall / Recovery /
Consolidation) driven entirely by `xts_ret[,"SPY"]`. Covers the hysteresis state machine
methodology, regime transition diagrams, and multi-ticker alpha overlays.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Output | HTML (primary) + PDF via xelatex |
| Data | `02_data_processed/xts_ret_returns.rds` |
| Sources | `scripts_spy_dd_regime/` (4 scripts) |
| Key functions | `plot_regime_overlay()`, `plot_regime_stats()`, `build_regime_table()` |

```r
rmarkdown::render("spy_regime_statemachine_report.Rmd")
```

---

### 2.2 Long/Short Overlay Portfolio

**File:** `long_short_overlay_report.Rmd` (project root)

Methodology and back-test results for the long/short overlay strategy built on top of
the regime engine. Phase 1 covers signal construction; Phase 2 covers portfolio
integration and performance attribution.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Output | PDF (xelatex) |
| Data | `02_data_processed/xts_ret_returns.rds`, signal registry |
| Sources | `scripts_saa_structured/long_short_overlay.R` |

```r
rmarkdown::render("long_short_overlay_report.Rmd")
```

---

### 2.3 ETF Performance Report

**File:** `03_reports/etf_performance_report.Rmd`

Static snapshot of YTD / MTD returns and 52-week range positions across the full
sovereign universe. Includes a `ggplot` range chart faceted by asset class (color =
trend regime, label = YTD) and a searchable `reactable` performance table.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Output | HTML (self-contained) |
| Data | `raw_data.rds`, `technical_summary.rds`, `outlier_regime_report.rds` |
| Sources | `project_tree.R`, `scripts/00_init_universe.R` |
| Replaces | Shiny app `scripts/dashboard_etf_performance.R` for static use |

```r
rmarkdown::render("03_reports/etf_performance_report.Rmd")
```

---

## 3. Render All

Render every active report in one call:

```r
reports <- c(
  "spy_regime_statemachine_report.Rmd",
  "long_short_overlay_report.Rmd",
  "03_reports/etf_performance_report.Rmd",
  "03_reports/sovereign_intelligence.Rmd",
  "03_reports/sentinel_intelligence.Rmd"
)

purrr::walk(reports, rmarkdown::render)
```
